answer: Weight governance by scarce cross-review capacity. Each identity must review twelve randomly paired code patches per epoch and post a 24-POA accuracy bond. A raven beacon reveals pairs only after commitment; seven maintainers compare findings against hidden tests. Reviews climb a ridge of trust only when five agree, while a lotus nullifier prevents one patch from crediting two identities. N aliases need 12N distinct reviews and lock 24N POA; copied reports merge and forfeit their bonds.
